architecture.cli: skills/trojancut/scripts/tc.py (argparse dispatcher) + modules: common.py (paths, ffprobe, brief, errors), ingest.py, analyze.py (cuts, beats, colour, LUT, frames+dedup adapted from claude-video), music.py (song analysis, parts, switches), sfx.py (classification, placement), make_sfx.py (deterministic built-in pack), planner.py (autoplan), validate.py, render.py (ffmpeg base + audio mix + engines), hf.py (HyperFrames overlay composition), check.py, project.py (template, open, notes.txt mapping), package.py (both skill ZIPs, install-skills)
architecture.engines: Both engines build the graded base video (per-shot segments -> concat/xfade) and the audio mix with ffmpeg. HyperFrames renders a transparent PNG-sequence overlay (animated title, animated logo, transition accents) composited over the base; ffmpeg engine overlays static Pillow-rendered title and logo PNGs. auto falls back to ffmpeg when HyperFrames is not usable or its render fails; report.json records engine and fallback reason.
architecture.hyperframes_install: setup runs npm ci from skills/trojancut/engine/package.json + package-lock.json (hyperframes 0.9.16 pinned) into TROJANCUT_HOME (default ~/.cache/trojancut or %LOCALAPPDATA%/TrojanCut), finds a Chrome (HYPERFRAMES_BROWSER_PATH, system Chrome/Chromium, or HyperFrames' own browser), smoke-renders once and writes a stamp so the second run is a check only. DO_NOT_TRACK=1 is set for every HyperFrames call. GSAP is the copy HyperFrames vendors in its dist.
architecture.claude_budget: index.json claude_images <= 28 (one 4x4 contact sheet per clip; grouped overview sheets when clips exceed 28), style.json claude_images <= 12 (deduplicated scene frames, 512 px); long arrays move to sidecar files if the two JSONs exceed 60 KB.
architecture.beats: numpy spectral-flux onset envelope, autocorrelation tempo in 60-180 BPM preferring the faster octave when its sub-beat is strong, phase + period refined by least squares on detected onsets, downbeat = strongest of 4 beat offsets.
architecture.grade: per-channel mean/std transfer from aggregate footage colour to aggregate reference colour baked into a 17^3 .cube at match strength; applied with lut3d before overlays so logo/title keep their colours.
architecture.sfx_pack: make_sfx.py synthesizes whoosh, swoosh, riser, impact, subdrop, hit, glitch, pop, shutter (3 variants each) with numpy + a fixed xorshift PRNG, 44.1 kHz mono 16-bit WAV peak-normalised to -1 dBFS, plus manifest.json; committed under skills/trojancut/sfx/.
architecture.template: deterministic zip (fixed timestamps/order) built by tc.py template; not committed (RESERVED: built zips); package and install-skills generate it into the templatetrojancut skill.

test_strategy: Acceptance tests generate their own synthetic media with ffmpeg/numpy (varied: 16:9, 1:1, 9:16 clips, 24/25/30 fps, silent refs, no-music briefs, 25-clip project, songs at 100/150 BPM with distinct pitches) and measure outputs independently (ffprobe, frame pixels, FFT band energy). Shared helpers in tests/acceptance/trojancut/_helpers.py (not conftest.py, which the hooks protect).
assumptions: notes.txt missing: open writes defaults and prints a note; SKILL.md then asks one message of questions.
Songs not named in 'Song order' play after the named ones, alphabetically.
Brief keys absent -> defaults: music none when absent, sfx_amount some, sfx_source both, song_switch auto, keep_clip_audio false.
Stills in footage/ are indexed as images but not cut into the edit (v1).
chrome-headless-shell cannot be downloaded on this VM; system Chrome is used via HYPERFRAMES_BROWSER_PATH detection.
notes.txt: questions matched by leading words before any parenthesis (case-insensitive); everything after the 'Anything else' line is kept verbatim as brief.yaml notes.
